description:
Mark Lawless Auctioneers are delighted to bring to the market No. 37 Killane View, a beautifully presented three-bedroom semi-detached home situated in this highly sought-after residential development in Edenderry.
Presented in excellent turn-key condition, this welcoming family home has been tastefully decorated throughout and offers bright, well-proportioned accommodation in a peaceful setting. Ideally positioned in a quiet cul-de-sac, the property is within easy walking distance of a wide range of local amenities, including schools, shops, churches and Edenderry’s picturesque canal walkways.
The accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hall, bright and comfortable sitting room, kitchen/dining area and guest WC. Upstairs, there are three well-appointed bedrooms, with the main bedroom benefiting from an en-suite, along with a family bathroom.
Externally, the property is equally impressive, with attractive and low-maintenance gardens to the front and rear. The rear garden provides an excellent space for outdoor relaxation and entertaining and features a garden shed, gazebo and dedicated BBQ area — ideal for enjoying summer evenings with family and friends.
A standout feature of the property is the convenient side access, which leads to a carport and roller door, providing excellent off-street parking together with secure vehicular access to the rear.
Edenderry is a thriving and well-established town offering an excellent range of amenities and services close at hand. These include a selection of primary and secondary schools, supermarkets, local shops, pubs, restaurants, sporting and activity clubs, as well as a range of transport services.
The town is also ideally located for commuters, with Dublin City Centre approximately one hour away and the M4 motorway approximately 20 minutes by car.
No. 37 Killane View represents an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers, families or those seeking a well-maintained home in a popular and convenient residential location.
Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the quality, presentation and many features this lovely home has to offer.
